BiblicalUsage: Reumah was the concubine of Nahor, Abraham's brother, and the mother of Tebah, Gaham, Thahash and Maachah. She is named once, in the record of Nahor's family.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that even a single line in the genealogy is there because God counted her children among His people.
